services_intro: The production work Lisa-Rec Inc. takes on. Beyond composition, we handle recording, finishing and mastering in our own studio.
svc1:
Commercial music & sound logos

Music for TV, radio and web commercials, commercial songs, and sound logos for companies and products. We handle 15-, 30- and 60-second edits and separate instrumental and karaoke versions.
svc2:
Music for facilities & spaces

Permanent background music for commercial and tourist facilities, and music for in-house video and projection. Our credits include multichannel work such as 4.0-channel surround.
svc3:
Game & anime music

Music and sound effects for fighting games, scores and theme songs for TV anime. Since 1997 we have worked on titles distributed worldwide, including the MELTY BLOOD and UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH series and the TV anime SK8 the Infinity.
svc4:
Vocal & narration recording

From selecting and booking vocalists and narrators to recording in our own studio and mixing. We also direct recordings performed by talent and cast members themselves.
svc5:
Post-production, mastering & sound effects

Audio post-production for drama, television and corporate video, sound-effect creation and placement, and loudness adjustment. We usually work from your rough cut.
svc6:
AI vocals & AI voice

Layering AI vocals with human singing, or producing narration variations with AI voice, with commercials that have actually aired. We propose the right mix of human and AI for each purpose.
brands_intro: Advertisers and operators of the commercials and facilities Lisa-Rec Inc. has scored. Most work comes through advertising agencies and production companies.

global_p: The ability to communicate in one hearing, built on local commercials, and the craft to make work that is loved for years. Both are the strength of Lisa-Rec’s sound.
artist_alt: Composer Raito, founder and CEO of Lisa-Rec Inc.
artist_bio:
Composer Raito (来兎, real name Masaru Kuba) was born in Okinawa City. He started making music on a computer in elementary school, founded a game-development circle with friends at a technical college, and began composing game music professionally in 1997 before moving to Tokyo in 2001.

He wrote the sound of the fighting-game series MELTY BLOOD, then broadened his work to titles released in Japan and abroad, including the UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH series and the TV anime SK8 the Infinity, covering theme songs, scores, sound effects and songs for artists.

He returned to Okinawa in 2009 and founded Lisa-Rec Inc. in 2010. Based in Naha, he now brings the pop, catchy writing honed in game music to commercials, sound logos, music for facilities and spaces, and music editing and sound design for VR live events.

faq.q: Who composes the commercial music and sound logos?
faq.a: Every one of the 150+ commercials and sound logos produced by Lisa-Rec Inc. from 2010 to 2026 was composed and produced by our founder and CEO, composer Raito (来兎, real name Masaru Kuba), the same Raito known for the game music of MELTY BLOOD and UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH.

faq.q: How do you take on work?
faq.a: We keep to projects where we are involved from the planning stage. As a rule we do not take part in competitive bids or pitches.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Japan?
faq.a: International inquiries and work for overseas releases are handled through Raito.studio, the English site of our founder, composer Raito. He has scored fighting games and TV anime distributed worldwide and works in English. Lisa-Rec Inc. (this site) handles work within Japan.

faq.q: What does a commercial track or sound logo cost?
faq.a: Sound logos and commercial tracks start from 300,000 yen. The fee depends on vocalists, recording attendance, additional edits and the scope of use. We quote after hearing about the project.
Two to three weeks for a sound logo and three weeks to a month for a commercial track are standard. Ask us about rush work. We schedule backwards from the air date.

faq.q: Can we commission you directly, without an agency?
faq.a: Yes. We accept work through advertising agencies and video production companies, and directly from businesses. Either way, we start by understanding the intent of the campaign.

faq.q: Do you take work from outside Okinawa?
faq.a: Yes. We are based in Naha, Okinawa, and work continuously with game, anime and advertising companies in Tokyo. Everything from meetings to delivery can be done online.

faq.q: Can you arrange singers and narrators?
faq.a: Yes. We select and book vocalists and narrators to suit the track, record in our own studio and mix. We also direct recordings sung by talent and cast members themselves.

faq.q: Can you produce with AI vocals or AI voice?
faq.a: Yes. Commercials that layer AI vocals with human singing have aired, and we also produce narration variations with AI voice. We propose the right balance between the qualities only a human voice has and the advantages of AI.

faq.q: Can we commission only post-production or sound effects?
faq.a: Yes. We handle audio post-production for drama, television and corporate video, the creation and placement of sound effects, and loudness adjustment, usually working from your rough cut.
